dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent O-shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, irregular outer perimeters where dark fur transitions into light-colored bands. The most distinct rings in the upper-mid section show a feathered gradient transition with irregular thickness along the circumference.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters in the central-lateral region. These asymmetrical blobs lack internal gradients and are concentrated between the larger macro-annuli, particularly in the lower-left quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the dorsal-central region form an obtuse triangle. Four distinct high-intensity blobs in the lower-central region form an irregular quadrilateral with varying interior angles.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a continuous, interlocking network of light-colored ring patterns that merge into a labyrinthine topology across the dorsal ridge.
